Watch the official trailer for Star City, the upcoming sci-fi alternate history series set in the world of For All Mankind. The series explores the Soviet side of the space race, following cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers behind the Iron Curtain as the race for the moon becomes a dangerous battle of ambition, secrecy, and survival.

Star City premieres May 29, 2026 on Apple TV.

Starring Rhys Ifans, Anna Maxwell Martin, Agnes O’Casey, Alice Englert, Solly McLeod, Adam Nagaitis, Ruby Ashbourne Serkis, Josef Davies, and Priya Kansara. Created by Ben Nedivi, Matt Wolpert, and Ronald D. Moore.
